definitions.explanation: One of two or more forms of the same element whose atoms have different numbers of neutrons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{炭素|たんそ}→炭素：06583_tanso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{同位体|どういたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To study the isotopes of carbon.
